title: pvRectilinearGridConnectivity
body:
## pvRectilinearGridConnectivity

Extracts material fragments from rectilinear-grid data (single grids or multiblock collections, typically CTH results) using cell-centred volume-fraction arrays and an isovalue. Fragments are built at sub-cell resolution with an extended marching-cubes table, connected across blocks and MPI processes, and returned as a multiblock dataset with one polydata block per material; cell data carry FragmentId and the integrated attributes such as MaterialVolume. Choose it for fragment counting and volume integration on rectilinear CTH data; for AMR input use pvMaterialInterfaceFilter or pvAMRFragmentsFilter.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Select at least one volume-fraction array; none is selected by default, so the filter produces nothing until you name one.
- All selected volume-fraction arrays must have the same data type; mixing float, double and unsigned-char arrays stops the filter.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI or client-server behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `RectilinearGridConnectivity`. Identity: `filters/RectilinearGridConnectivity`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the filter. Accepted data: rectilinear grids (vtkRectilinearGrid); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). The input needs at least one cell-centred array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkRectilinearGrid","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DoubleVolumeArrays` | This property specifies the name(s) of the volume fraction array(s) for generating parts. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FloatVolumeArrays` | This property specifies the name(s) of the volume fraction array(s) for generating parts. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `UnsignedCharacterVolumeArrays` | This property specifies the name(s) of the volume fraction array(s) for generating parts. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `VolumeFractionValue` | The value of this property is the volume fraction value for the surface. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvRectilinearGridConnectivity",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
